_comment: NEW 'India' tab, to be appended to your real 'Invoice Traker.xlsx' master workbook. Columns match the REAL sheet you uploaded (Invoice details 1.xlsx — 1400+ real rows: Jai Balaji Industries, Captain Steel India, SBI General Insurance, etc.) exactly, in the same order. That real sheet has NO HSN or client-GSTIN column — those are added below as columns anyway (blank unless a CP email happens to supply them) since a GST tax invoice legally needs them; see EXTRA COLUMNS note.
_extra_columns_note: The first 21 columns (Sl. No. through SPOC) are EXACTLY your real sheet's columns, same order. The 7 after that (GSTIN, HSN/SAC, PF ID, Invoice Description, Client Contact Person, Client Mail To, INT CC Mail) do NOT exist in your real sheet — they're appended here so the pipeline has somewhere to put a client's GSTIN/HSN and the drafting-stage data (description, contact, emails), the same way USA/UK/Poland needed extra handling for data their sheets don't carry either. Kept per your confirmed decision (2026-08-11: 'Keep the 7 extra columns'). 'Review Status' and 'Email Drafted' are the two-phase-flow manual-review gate added to USA/UK/Poland (2 independent flags, not one text-state column — see append_invoice_to_excel.py's module comment). 'MIS Verified' (2026-08-12) is the real MIS project-info API check (see src/mis/mis_api.py). All 3 are added for consistency even though India isn't wired into entity_resolver.py yet, so they're currently a no-op.
_tax_note: Set to CGST+SGST @ 9%/9% always, per your instruction — but the real sheet you uploaded actually has BOTH kinds: e.g. Jai Balaji Industries is CGST+SGST 9%/9% (intra-state), while SBI General Insurance and UTI Asset Management are IGST 18% only (inter-state, CGST/SGST both zero). Flagging this because it means some real clients WOULD get the wrong tax type under an always-CGST+SGST rule — worth revisiting once you're ready to decide how the system should tell them apart (client state vs. your registered state is the actual GST rule).
